_comment: Native pi (>=1.4) MCP config. pi-ctf materializes this into the agent dir (~/.pi/agent/mcp.json) at launch, applying PI_DEFER. Same `mcpServers` shape every MCP client uses, plus pi's `exposure`/`description`/`toolExposure`. exposure: deferred = tools hidden until the model finds them with `tool_search`, then called directly (default here). Alternatives: codemode (script-only), direct (declared up front, = PI_DEFER=off), hidden. `description` feeds the compact mcp_servers index in the system prompt and the BM25 ranker. Override a single tool with toolExposure, e.g. "toolExposure": { "scope_*": "direct" } to always-load matching tools.
